people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”
translations.bsb: “Fallen is Virgin Israel, never to rise again. She lies abandoned on her land, with no one to raise her up.”
translations.kjv: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
translations.asv: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is cast down upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
